spec_basis: STU-LAY-006: Parent pages ... MUST support multiple parents applied ..., parent-based-on-parent inheritance, cascading changes; nested parents; application to page ranges

STU-LAY-007: override a single parent item on a document page, override-all ..., detach an overridden item from its parent, remove overrides ... 'cannot unlink an item that was not overridden', which Studio MUST reproduce as a distinct typed error
STU-LAY-110: remove_override (restore inheritance) and detach (sever the link permanently); they are DIFFERENT operations with different results and MUST NOT be merged

STU-LAY-122: five typed references parent_story, start_text_frame, end_text_frame, previous_text_frame, next_text_frame, plus text_frame_index and overflows ... test for overset without rendering. In/out ports on each frame MUST expose the chain in the operator UI, and a threads-view overlay MUST visualise flow order
STU-LAY-026: story editor MUST present a StudioTextStory as linear text with a style column, depth indicator, overset marker ... editing the same story authority as the layout view
STU-LAY-037: based-on inheritance ...; next-style chaining ...; override handling with an override indicator ... clear-overrides with character-versus-paragraph scoping
STU-LAY-038: Pattern (regular-expression) styles MUST apply a character style automatically to every regular-expression match ...; stored ON the style

STU-LAY-143: style name MUST NOT be empty; MUST be unique within its scope; MUST NOT exceed a maximum length; MUST NOT contain a bracket character; a based-on chain MUST NOT be circular ... Each of these is a SEPARATE typed error

STU-LAY-027/129: find/change surface ... find.text (literal text with metacharacter tokens, case and whole-word toggles), find.grep (regular expressions with capture groups ...); scope document, story, selection; 'object contains no text for find/change' is a distinct typed error and MUST NOT be reported as 'no matches'
STU-LAY-035/141: tables (StudioTable in longdoc records; cell contract)

STU-LAY-055: live preflight engine that continuously validates the active document against a selected profile, reporting an error count and per-error fix information, limitable to a page range, with a status indicator
STU-LAY-154: preflight_rule_flag severity.disabled/error/warning/informational; profile = named set of rule instances
STU-LAY-057: rule categories ...; findings MUST be surfaced ... as STRUCTURED findings carrying the rule id, the severity, the offending object reference and the page
